description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It also contains macros for non-copyable and non-movable classes, and includes licensing information.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for representing and validating expected values, ranges, or regex patterns for a type T.

classes.name: ValidatorBase
classes.description: Base class for validators, providing a virtual destructor.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class inheriting from ValidatorBase, implementing validation logic based on expected values or custom functions.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: ExpectedValues::validate
methods.description: Validates a value of type T against the stored expected values, range, or regex.

methods.name: Validator::validate
methods.description: Validates a value of type T using either expected values or a custom function.

methods.name: ValidationManager::validate
methods.description: Validates a value against registered validators for a given key.
